# Hi, I'm Savannah.

I'm a Master of Public Policy student at the University of Virginia's Frank Batten School of Leadership and Public Policy.

My work focuses on evidence-based policymaking, housing policy, and quantitative research. I am passionate about using research and data to better understand complex policy challenges and develop meaningful solutions.

## A Little About Me

I am interested in the intersection of research, public service, and policymaking.

My academic and professional experiences have allowed me to explore issues ranging from Irish social housing policy to congressional reform and impact evaluation.

Through this website, I hope to share some of the projects, research, and experiences that have shaped my work.
